statement: Если Master опускает руку до подсчёта голоса Butler, Butler обязан немедленно опустить руку.
reason: A live table gesture: the Butler must lower a raised hand when the Master lowers theirs before the tally. The engine stores votes and emits a private warning after the fact; it has no hand state and no engine-visible consequence. Source: Butler r3120 Summary.

statement: Butler может свободно поддерживать изгнание Traveller, поскольку изгнание не является голосованием.
reason: Out of scope: Travellers and exile are not modelled in this edition, so there is no exile record to exempt from the Butler's master restriction.

statement: Evil Travellers учитываются, если они присоединились к игре до действия Chef.
reason: Out of scope: Travellers are not modelled in this edition, so an evil Traveller can never join the seat ring the Chef counts.

statement: Информация Empath верна на рассвете, а не на закате, поскольку он действует после Demon.
reason: The Empath acts after the Demon, so its answer reflects the night's deaths. Asserted by the other-night queue.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::the other-night order places the Monk before the Imp and the Spy last (SYS-NIGHT-01) — the queue is ['poisoner','monk','imp','empath','fortuneteller','butler','spy'], placing the Empath after the Demon's attack.

statement: Ведущий выбирает Red Herring; им может быть любой good-игрок, включая самого Fortune Teller.
reason: The Storyteller chooses the red herring, and any good player including the Fortune Teller is legal. Asserted by the setup command and the self-herring test.
evidence: src/core/engine/commands.test.ts::setup commands validate order, herring and bag patches — setHerring is allowed for a good player, rejected for an evil player, and can be cleared; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::the Fortune Teller may be their own red herring — herringId '1' is a legal setup and answers yes.

statement: В маленьких играх иногда рекомендуется сделать Fortune Teller собственным Red Herring.
reason: Explicit Storyteller advice for small games. It prescribes no game state and has no engine-visible consequence. Source: Fortune Teller r3123 How to Run.

statement: На рассвете Ведущий объявляет, кто умер ночью, не называя причину.
reason: The acceptance finale asserts the public view names deaths without their causes, so players learn who died, not how.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/acceptance.test.ts::a played finale replays to the same state and exposes no secrets.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Imp.r3116.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Если Imp умирает, good побеждает, если только его смерть не запускает другую способность (например, Scarlet Woman) или Mastermind.
reason: The heir tests assert no winner when the Scarlet Woman inherits and a good win when the Demon has no heir; the Mastermind branch is separately covered.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Slayer shot at five alive lets the Scarlet Woman inherit the Demon role (TB-SLAYER-01, TB-SCARLETWOMAN-01).
test: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a Slayer shot below five alive ends the game when the Demon has no heir (TB-SLAYER-01).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Imp.r3116.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Reminder-жетоны Investigator рекомендуется убрать, когда это удобно.
reason: Reminder-token hygiene advice, not a game rule. Tokens are physical aids and have no engine-visible consequence. Source: Investigator r2983 How to Run.

statement: При перенаправлении смерти игроки узнают только, кто умер, но не почему.
reason: The acceptance finale asserts the public view names deaths without causes; the Mayor redirect is journaled for the host, not disclosed to the group.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/acceptance.test.ts::a played finale replays to the same state and exposes no secrets.
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Mayor.r2995.wikitext § Summary.

statement: Travellers считаются игроками для победы Mayor и должны быть изгнаны до неё; изгнание не является казнью.
reason: Out of scope: Travellers and exile are not modelled in this edition, so no live Traveller can change the three-alive Mayor count and no exile record exists.

statement: Fabled не считаются игроками для победы Mayor.
reason: Out of scope: Fabled are not modelled in this edition, so no Fabled token can be counted among or excluded from the players.

statement: Ведущему рекомендуется сохранять Mayor живым до финального дня; в редких случаях, если группа уверена в Mayor слишком рано, можно позволить ему умереть.
reason: Explicit Storyteller advice about pacing and keeping the Mayor alive. It prescribes no game state and has no engine-visible consequence. Source: Mayor r2995 How to Run.

statement: Защита Monk предотвращает и другие вредные эффекты способности Demon, например отравление или смену alignment.
reason: The pinned sentence is explicitly other-editions: a TB Demon has no non-killing ability, and mixed-edition scripts are rejected. There is no TB mechanical input.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Monk.r3124.wikitext § How to Run — in other editions, Demons may have abilities other than killing.
test: src/core/engine/scripts.test.ts::script limits reject mixed editions, unknown roles and short rosters.

statement: Отравленный игрок не имеет способности, но Ведущий изображает её наличие и может давать ложную информацию.
reason: The poisoned player's ability has no effect, and the Storyteller may give false information. Both clauses are asserted by existing tests.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a poisoned Monk protects no one and the Imp's attack kills (TB-MONK-01) — the poisoned ability has no effect; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::every Trouble Brewing first-night information role offers allowed false information while impaired (SYS-EFFECTS-01, TB-EMPATH-03) — each impaired information role is offered false information.

statement: Отравленный игрок просыпается и действует как обычно, не зная об отравлении.
reason: The poisoned player still wakes for their step. Asserted by the poisoned Spy step; the player's ignorance is table information with no engine state.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a poisoned Spy is shown the grimoire without a question and the step is marked impaired (TB-SPY-01, SYS-EFFECTS-01) — the poisoned player still has and completes the night step, marked impaired.

statement: Если отравленный игрок использует способность "once per game", она считается использованной.
reason: A poisoned player's once-per-game ability counts as used. Asserted by the poisoned Slayer shot.
evidence: src/core/engine/tb-audit.test.ts::a poisoned Slayer spends the once-per-game ability without killing (TB-SLAYER-01) — used.slayer is true and the target stays alive.

statement: Если Poisoner покидает игру или меняет персонажа, эффект отравления прекращается.
reason: The test kills the Poisoner and clears the effect, but the cited Examples section covers only becoming the Imp; the leaves-the-game clause is in How to Run.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a dead player's persistent ability effects end immediately (SYS-EFFECTS-05).
wiki: docs/official/wiki/Poisoner.r1737.wikitext § How to Run.

statement: Ведущему рекомендуется не позволять игрокам обсуждать свои ночные действия в момент их совершения.
reason: Advice about table conduct: not letting players discuss their night actions while they happen. It has no engine-visible consequence. Source: Ravenkeeper r3125 How to Run.

statement: Travellers не учитываются при подсчёте пяти живых игроков.
reason: Out of scope: Travellers are not modelled in this edition, so none can enter the living count the Scarlet Woman's five-player threshold reads.

statement: Soldier защищён и от других вредных эффектов способности Demon, например от отравления или смены alignment.
reason: The pinned sentence is other-editions: a TB Soldier cannot face a non-killing Demon, and mixed-edition scripts are rejected.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Soldier.r3121.wikitext § How to Run — in other editions.
test: src/core/engine/scripts.test.ts::script limits reject mixed editions, unknown roles and short rosters.

statement: При нескольких казнях со смертью в день Ведущий выбирает, какого персонажа показать.
reason: Trouble Brewing has one execution per day; the extra-execution clause is explicitly other-editions and has no TB input.
evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Undertaker.r3115.wikitext § How to Run — in Trouble Brewing there is one execution per day; other editions differ.

statement: Если номинировавший не Townsfolk, ничего не происходит и голосование продолжается как обычно.
reason: A non-Townsfolk nominator triggers nothing and the nomination remains open. Asserted by the Drunk nominator.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Drunk nominator does not trigger the Virgin — result.virgin is false, the nominator stays alive, and day.nominations.length is 1, so the nomination ledger stays open.

statement: После первой номинации Virgin теряет способность — независимо от того, умер номинировавший или нет, и даже если Virgin был drunk или poisoned.
reason: The ability is spent after the first nomination whether the nominator lives or dies and even when the Virgin is impaired. Asserted across three tests.
evidence: src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::an impaired Virgin's first nomination still spends the ability — used.virgin is true with an active poison; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::a Spy that does not register as a Townsfolk leaves the Virgin alive but spent — used.virgin is true although the nominator lives; src/core/engine/engine.test.ts::Virgin executes only the first eligible Townsfolk nominator — the nominator dies and the Virgin stays alive, covering the nominator-death branch.

statement: Reminder-жетоны Washerwoman рекомендуется убрать, когда это удобно.
reason: Reminder-token hygiene advice, not a game rule. Tokens are physical aids and have no engine-visible consequence. Source: Washerwoman r2630 How to Run.
